messages:
Maria Chen: Quick proposal — we should prioritize tenant signals for SLO alerts by (1) tenant error rate delta, (2) recent exposure, (3) quota burn rate. Idea is to use a weighted score so high-exposure low-error tenants don't drown alerts.

Ajay Patel: +1 to weighted score. how do you compute exposure?

Maria Chen: exposure = rolling 6h request volume normalized by global 6h. weight: 0..1

Kevin O'Neill: Concern: this changes fanout drastically. need a cap per-minute to avoid pager storms.

Nina Gomez: Agree. Add a soft-ratecap per-tenant and hard global cap. soft cap triggers sampling instead of full fanout.

Ajay Patel: Can we map this into current notify API? sample payload:
```
POST /notify/fanout
{
  "slo_id": "slo_123",
  "priority_score": 0.72,
  "fanout_strategy": "priority-sample",
  "caps": {"soft_per_tenant": 3, "hard_global": 200}
}
```

Kevin O'Neill: That helps. What about telemetry? need fields to debug: priority_score, exposure_window, quota_burn_pct, sampled_reason.

Maria Chen: Yes. Console should show a per-alert breakdown: score, why it was sampled, which route was chosen. UX: small expandable row on SLO card.

SLOBot: Automated note: new telemetry fields will increase event size by ~20 bytes per alert. :robot_face:

Ajay Patel: Back-compat: keep default fanout behavior unchanged unless policy set to "priority-sample". Don't surprise customers.

Nina Gomez: Rollout plan: feature flag per-org, staged at 10% -> 50% -> 100% over two weeks. Ops runbook to revert.

Kevin O'Neill: Tests: synthetic load test to ensure global cap prevents >200 notifications/sec. I'll add to eng-releases test harness.

Maria Chen: API debate: do we expose priority_score as a numeric field clients can set? I'd prefer server-derived only to avoid gaming scores.

Ajay Patel: Server-derived only. Allow client hint ("importance_hint": "business-critical") which maps to a small multiplier.

Nina Gomez: UX question: console needs toggle: "Show sampling reasons" default off for orgs with >10M alerts/month.

Kevin O'Neill: Also need a dashboard panel: sampled vs delivered over time + top tenants by sampled_count.

Maria Chen: Agreed. Can someone add a draft telemetry schema and minimal console mock? Nina?

Nina Gomez: On it. I'll post mocks in #design but will attach a minimal JSON schema here in next message.

OpsBot: Reminder: please add runbook steps for "priority-sample" rollback. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/priority-sample

Ajay Patel: Nits: naming. prefer "priority-sampling" over "priority-sample".

Maria Chen: Happy to rename. final list:
- scoring fields: error_delta, exposure, quota_burn, importance_hint
- fanout strategies: default, priority-sampling
- caps: soft_per_tenant, hard_global
- telemetry: priority_score, sampled_reason, route_chosen

Kevin O'Neill: I'll add rateproofing and tests. tagging @eng-sre for FYI.

Nina Gomez: Will add console mock and toggle docs.

Maria Chen: OK. I'll write RFC draft and include rollout steps. Thanks all :tada:

SLOBot: Thread archived to RFC tracker: RFC-2024-45 :white_check_mark:
